changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 is the formal schema-valid Capsule used by Attempt 1 and carries unvalidated family hypotheses.
attempt1_failure_evidence: Attempt 1 is permanently settled against the exact V1 SHA and must not be rewritten as if the failure never occurred.
changes.candidate_change: Create a separate V1.1 Candidate with a new program ID and semantic version while binding the exact immutable V1 SHA as its baseline.
changes.why_capsule_local: Version lineage belongs to the Shanyeji capsule family and changes no compiler or schema behavior.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Candidate validation must retain V1 and Attempt-1 evidence byte-identically and compare the new candidate against that fixed baseline.

changes.field_or_mechanism_affected: transfer_model.fixed_invariants, degrees_of_freedom, do_not_copy and local anti-shortcut policy
changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 excluded literal copying but still allowed an apparent family resemblance to be carried by a giant light title, brush surface, dark kitchen, wok, mountain and accent bundle.
attempt1_failure_evidence: SURFACE_TOKEN_COLLAPSE
F1/F2/F3 resemblance relied disproportionately on repeated surface styling.
changes.candidate_change: Classify the repeated bundle only as surface observation, degree of freedom or anti-shortcut exclusion and forbid it from satisfying a FAMILY pass.
changes.why_capsule_local: The failure is proven only for Shanyeji V1 plus Attempt 1; no cross-capsule global taste claim is made.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Several predeclared surface fields change while preserved family relationships remain explainable without citing the bundle as primary evidence.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 described an authored irregular display object but bounded erosion and surface behavior remained easy to interpret as a large brush-calligraphy recipe.
attempt1_failure_evidence: SURFACE_TOKEN_COLLAPSE
F2 showed that photographic realism could coexist with a generic brush-title shortcut.
changes.candidate_change: Define structural display mass through optical mass, internal negative-space topology, glyph-group balance, photo counter-mass relation and first-read authority; move brush, ink, erosion, roughness and distress into optional surface treatment.
changes.why_capsule_local: This is a refinement of one capsule mechanism hypothesis, not a global prohibition on brush or calligraphic lettering.
changes.future_retest_criterion: A non-brush implementation can pass when the structural mechanism is preserved; GENERIC_BRUSH_CALLIGRAPHY_SHORTCUT fails when surface treatment substitutes for structure.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 operators stated what changes and what breaks the family but did not encode held constants, changed variables and prohibited leakage per progressive experiment tier.
attempt1_failure_evidence: OPERATOR_ISOLATION_FAILURE
F1 leaked active cooking/wok content intended for F2 and F1/F2 could not support clean attribution.
changes.candidate_change: Provide machine-readable F1/F2/F3 design constraints with HELD_CONSTANTS, CHANGED_VARIABLES and PROHIBITED_LEAKAGE plus an automatic leakage failure rule.
changes.why_capsule_local: The contract is specific to the next Shanyeji controlled experiment and remains outside the global VisualProgram schema.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Every future tier satisfies its declared records and no later-tier defining variable appears early.

changes.field_or_mechanism_affected: grid geometry, attention hierarchy, integration topology and COMPOSITION_VARIATION
changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 allowed movement but its reference-derived phrasing and Attempt-1 outputs did not sufficiently prevent repeated positional formulas.
attempt1_failure_evidence: GENERIC_CHINESE_RESTAURANT_POSTER_FALLBACK
F1 and F2 showed insufficient positional and topological differentiation.
changes.candidate_change: Encode title/photo counter-mass, support/quiet-pocket, photo-detail/graphic-density and reading-order relationships as a graph while explicitly excluding fixed title, wok, mountain and quiet-zone coordinates.
changes.why_capsule_local: The relation graph refines Shanyeji's local composition mechanism without altering global composition behavior.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Major masses move while the required relation graph and locally safe information placement remain reviewable.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 required recomposition rather than scaling but did not machine-encode zone reallocation, reading-order preservation or the observed generic vertical fallbacks.
attempt1_failure_evidence: ASPECT_ADAPTATION_FAILURE
F3 achieved a tall bitmap but did not prove native structural reflow.
changes.candidate_change: Require native target-aspect allocation of title, photographic action, support and closure zones with relation reflow; add explicit vertical-template, filler-token and stretch/stack failure conditions.
changes.why_capsule_local: The controls are a Shanyeji candidate operator policy and do not redefine the global ASPECT_ADAPT enum or schema.
changes.future_retest_criterion: With F2 subject/process and copy held constant, F3 shows native zone reallocation without new filler copy or motif.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 allowed rebinding or omission but motif presence remained easy to treat as expected visual completion.
attempt1_failure_evidence: ASPECT_ADAPTATION_FAILURE
F3 introduced an unnecessary mountain-line token.
changes.candidate_change: Set motif default to OMIT and require any inclusion to bind a new semantic source plus a named reviewable function; preserve the F3 mountain line only as negative evidence.
changes.why_capsule_local: This corrects one capsule's motif hypothesis and does not establish a global aesthetic ban on mountains, seals or scribbles.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Every future motif is absent or has explicit subject/process/identity derivation and an observable hierarchy, counterweight or semantic function.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 required local photo/type calibration and said quiet zones could move, but the controlled experiment did not preclude repeated overlay-template solutions explicitly enough.
attempt1_failure_evidence: GENERIC_CHINESE_RESTAURANT_POSTER_FALLBACK
Repeated composition increased the risk that a fixed dark information zone would be mistaken for integration.
changes.candidate_change: Require type-safe space to arise from crop, staging, luminance/frequency, depth, occlusion and counter-mass planning; forbid generic gradients, heavy shadows, fixed dark-left columns and copied empty zones.
changes.why_capsule_local: The integration policy is tied to the Shanyeji photo-design mechanism and its next controlled validation.
changes.future_retest_criterion: The safe region changes location across outputs and remains attributable to the photograph rather than a repeated overlay.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 listed many freedoms but Attempt 1 did not bind a pre-generation divergence matrix across the progressive tiers.
attempt1_failure_evidence: SURFACE_TOKEN_COLLAPSE
OPERATOR_ISOLATION_FAILURE
F1/F2/F3 could be explained by one obvious restaurant-poster template.
changes.candidate_change: Track and predeclare title geometry/location, photo-mass location, subject class, accent, motif, color family, depth staging and layout topology; require meaningful multi-field divergence including topology or major-mass movement.
changes.why_capsule_local: The divergence matrix is an experiment design control rather than a global aesthetic threshold.
changes.future_retest_criterion: A predeclared matrix exists before generation and human review confirms the intended fields actually diverged.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 named relational mechanisms but formal FAMILY pass criteria did not require a structured explanation that excludes palette, brush, mountain, wok or repeated composition as primary evidence.
attempt1_failure_evidence: GENERIC_CHINESE_RESTAURANT_POSTER_FALLBACK
Family resemblance was visible but causal mechanism transfer was not proven.
changes.candidate_change: Require hierarchy and counter-mass plus tonal/density and depth/semantic relationship evidence; surface matches are explicitly insufficient primary explanations.
changes.why_capsule_local: The criterion evaluates this candidate's proposed family mechanisms without asserting a universal visual-style rubric.
changes.future_retest_criterion: A reviewer can explain the family through the required relationship groups without relying primarily on surface-token matches.

changes.field_or_mechanism_affected: photography and integration quality gates plus independent score channels
changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 protected realism but did not encode a non-compensating separation between technical photographic quality and formal family mechanism validation.
attempt1_failure_evidence: F2 had the strongest photographic realism while formal FAMILY validation still failed.
changes.candidate_change: Score TECHNICAL_PHOTOGRAPHIC_REALISM independently from FAMILY_MECHANISM_VALIDATION and prohibit either channel from compensating for the other's hard failure.
changes.why_capsule_local: This is a validation design for the Shanyeji candidate and does not change the global human-aesthetic authority boundary.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Future review reports both scores separately and a realism PASS cannot override isolation, topology, motif, surface or aspect failure.

changes.old_v1_behavior: V1 was produced by the frozen global compiler and schema; Attempt 1 does not prove a global defect.
attempt1_failure_evidence: The failure registry explicitly records GLOBAL_COMPILER_HYPOTHESIS_ONLY and no proven global compiler defect.
changes.candidate_change: Keep the candidate schema-valid and place extra machine-readable validation controls in a capsule-local companion policy bound through identity and receipt.
changes.why_capsule_local: No independent cross-capsule evidence authorizes a global compiler or schema change.
changes.future_retest_criterion: Global compiler and schema hashes remain unchanged while the local policy is consumed by Attempt-2 design.
